label: Bible Study
prompt: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou requirest: for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a _____ woman.
verse: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou requirest: for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a virtuous woman.
note: Boaz's tribute to Ruth — the same phrase crowns the 'virtuous woman' poem in Proverbs 31.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: A _____ heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
verse: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
note: A merry heart shows up on the face — Solomon's version of 'smiles are contagious.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear, and the _____ that the king rideth upon, and the crown royal which is set upon his head:
verse: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear, and the horse that the king rideth upon, and the crown royal which is set upon his head:
note: Haman designed a royal parade thinking it was for himself — robe, crown, and the king's own horse. It was for Mordecai.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into _____: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verse: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
note: Isaiah's peace vision, and Micah 4:3 says it too — Joel 3:10 runs it backward as a call to war.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, _____ is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
verse: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
note: Paul quotes Deuteronomy 32:35 — 'Vengeance is mine' — as the reason to leave payback in God's hands.
